batch: Key letters are exactly balanced (6 each) with no obvious periodicity, and the spelling/capitalization items are clean 2x2 factorials, so letters and option shape there give nothing away. The cross-item pattern is in the comprehension items: in items 4 and 23 the key shares a clause with one distractor and the other half with another (medoid/shared-fragment construction), so a test-wise student who learns to pick the option overlapping most with its neighbours gains an edge.
